title: Activation Anchors: scaffold and onboarding screenshots for console first-run
creator: Ava Patel
description: Goal: Ship a compact, memorable first-run tour that surfaces the minimal actions a user needs to see value in Redwood Console (create project, connect model, run a test request). This ticket covers the visual assets and a set of product screenshots/mocks used by the tour and first-run checklist empty states. Focus on 'activation anchors' — small anchored tips and a pinned checklist that persist across route transitions.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 7 annotated PNG/JPG screenshots (desktop 1440x900) covering: empty projects, empty models, token usage empty state, first successful request view, quickstart checklist collapsed and expanded, and tour mid-step with spotlight overlay.
Figma file with full artboards and export-ready components for engineering: 1x, 2x, and optimized SVG for icons.
Copy approved by PM and UX writer: microcopy for tips (<= 90 chars), CTA labels, and onboarding checklist items.
Accessibility hints documented (contrast, focus trap behavior for spotlight modal) and alt text for each screenshot.
Hand-off notes to ENG with prop names and recommended CSS classes for anchored tips.
Design review sign-off recorded in comments and linked to the PR for onboarding endpoints (ENG-41234).
No blocking UX issues reported in stakeholder review; any minor feedback logged as follow-ups.
screenshots_needed: Empty Projects landing with pinned checklist (collapsed) and CTA 'Create Project'
Connect Model empty state showing recommended open models and a 'Quick Connect' flow
Successful test request modal and small telemetry indicator for token count
Checklist expanded view showing 3 primary activation steps: Create Project, Connect Model, Run Test
Spotlight step showing anchored tip on 'Run Test' button with keyboard focus state and dismiss X
Empty embeddings page with suggested dataset upload illustration
Rollouts empty state with CTA to 'Create rollout' and subtle help tip
decision_log: 2025-03-10: Chose anchored tips over full-screen tour to preserve console context (PM + Eng consensus).
2025-03-11: Use single-color silhouette illustrations to reduce cognitive load and align with brand tokens.
2025-03-12: Checklist limited to three steps to minimize friction; each step links to the relevant route rather than in-tour setup.
review_feedback: PM (Riley): Tone needs to be more action-oriented; replaced 'Get started' copy with 'Create project'.
Eng (Sofia): Spotlight overlay should not trap existing keyboard shortcuts — documented focus behavior in hand-off.
Security (Omar): Confirm that tour assets don't leak telemetry; answered in comments and added a flag for telemetry opt-out.
next_steps: Export 1x/2x PNGs and SVG icons and upload to Drive (assigned to designer).
Create PR referencing ENG-41234 with JSON payload schema for tour steps (assigned to eng).
PM to confirm tracking events and success criteria for deprecating old walkthrough (PM-274).
Schedule a 30-minute handoff with FE on 2025-03-17 to review animation specs.
accessibility_notes: All CTAs meet AA contrast when overlay is present.
Spotlight overlays provide aria-live updates and focus is trapped to the overlay when expanded; escape closes and returns focus to the originating button.
Provide alt text for each exported screenshot; copy included in drive/microcopy-onboarding-v1.md.
handoff_instructions: Bundle artboards under /artboards with clear filenames and a README describing intended route and state.
Icons exported as optimized SVGs and PNG fallbacks; include CSS variable tokens for colors.
Provide the sample JSON that maps step ids to route paths and action hooks (see hand-off/engineering-onboard-annotations.csv).
